_comment: Homepage transfer news banner — hand-edited, never touched by scripts/update_data.py. Set "enabled" to false to hide the banner without deleting this file. "league" is the league these transfers happened in (e.g. FA26-L1) — teams are reshuffled between leagues, so the banner only shows while that league is the site's latest one and disappears by itself when the next league starts; set it to the new league id when announcing moves within it. "heading" is the small label shown before the list (Korean mode); "heading_en" is the English version (falls back to "heading" if missing). Each transfer needs "player" (must match a name in player_profiles.json exactly) and "to" (the destination team, exactly as used elsewhere — see the teams tab / src/data/leagues.json for team names on record). "from" is optional: without it, the previous team is looked up automatically from player_profiles.json's team_history (falling back to current_team) — but that only works once the Sheet has a week recorded under the new team. Set "from" explicitly if you announce a move before that (an entry auto-resolving to the same from/to team is dropped rather than shown as a no-op). All four below now read correctly from team_history as of the week 3 regen, so their "from" overrides were removed.
